text: Under 49 U.S.C. § 30120(a), when notice of a defect or noncompliance is required, the manufacturer must remedy it without charge when the vehicle is presented. Section 30120(g)(1) says that no-charge duty does not apply if the vehicle was bought by the first purchaser more than 15 calendar years before notice under § 30118(c) or an order under § 30118(b), whichever is earlier. The cutoff is that first-sale date, not mileage and not how many later owners the vehicle has had.
